summary: SAP Technical Consultant with 3+ years in SAP S/4HANA, specialising in integration and master data. At Laidon Group I deliver the ABAP/RAP backend and SAP Integration Suite flows for SimpleMDG on SAP BTP across 10 US and EU customer implementations, cutting OData response times by up to 94%.

Before that, three years at FPT IS gave me the delivery grounding: ABAP development across seven modules, PI/PO and SAP CI-DS integration, and a 300-million-record data warehouse. I run AI coding agents behind human review gates, and hold 4 SAP certifications including Solution Architect – SAP BTP.
